issues: The source does not identify the first-person speaker as Nephi; the scene asserts this in its characters, summary, and dialogue attribution.
The summary says the owner expects grapes, but source verse 2 says he “looked that it should bring forth grapes”; the corresponding narration omits that source detail.
The summary says the owner “makes” a wine-press, which changes the source’s “made” into present-tense action and risks portraying narrated song imagery as a current event.

The characters list includes the Lord of Hosts and God that is holy, although the verses only mention them in prophetic statements and do not establish them as physically present. Do not depict them as visible figures.
